main.description: What the host is: its DID, which tokens for its methods are addressed to and which a client checks against the origin it reached the host at; the domain its scopes' handles are under; the scope names it reserves; its limits; whether a new scope waits for the operator's approval; and the host methods it serves. Public.

scopeApproval.description: Whether a new scope waits for the host's operator to approve it before its organization can create packages.

methods.description: The host methods this host serves, by NSID.

maxBlobSize.description: The largest artifact uploadArtifact stores, in bytes.
